When Minneapolis Council Member LaTrisha Vetaw and I saw each other at a Prince celebration (where all good things happen), we ended up talking about how we could make the Camden railroad crossing safer. Frequent train blockages delay first responders, drivers, and pedestrians trying to get across.

That's why I’ve worked with Council Member Vetaw to secure federal funding to address the three at-grade rail crossings and make this area safer for everyone.
